I'm Daniele. I started as a b-boy, then DJed the breaking trainings at the Buridda, the hip hop jams and the AQA Cafè residency. After that, a long break: day job, marriage, a family. Then I got back to work, and this time I make records too.

My first album, Uncertain Identity, I wrote and directed, and an AI generated it. Since then I started producing directly on my own. When AI is involved, it says so.

Short bio, copy and paste it
DJ Danny-T is a DJ and producer from Genova, Italy. B-boy by origin, he DJed breaking trainings, jams and clubs in Genova from 2009 to 2013, and came back to the decks in 2026 after a long break. He plays dancehall, dubstep, techno and hip hop, and since 2026 releases his own music: hand-made, or made with AI and declared as such.

Tech rider

I bring

  • Pioneer DDJ-SB, plus a Numark V7 if needed
  • Laptop with VirtualDJ and Serato
  • Audio interface for DVS: I can plug into any mixer and turntables with my laptop. I can bring the vinyl records.

Or I use yours

  • Any mixer with two free channels
  • Any DJ controller: I just need the model, I'll have the drivers ready
  • CDJs: rekordbox USB stick or laptop, just let me know the space available

I need

  • A table, a power socket, a booth monitor
  • A sound system to plug into. Let's agree on the available connections beforehand, so we both come prepared.
